title: Qt: Manually connect our "Capture" menu actions.

notes.body: enabled an automatic merge when the pipeline for fcdb77dce9be78725d6bf3eab7560b3574423d0a succeeds

with QT5.12.12 I'm getting warnings after this change

[GUI WARNING] -- QObject::connect: No such slot WiresharkMainWindow::on_actionCaptureOptions_triggered() in wireshark/ui/qt/main.cpp:700

[GUI WARNING] -- QObject::connect:  (receiver name: 'WiresharkMainWindow')

Not sure which part that triggers this warning
could maybe that on_actionCaptureOptions_triggered is still called in two other places :D
Thanks for catching this. Fix inbound in !8264.
